v0_1_start_conditions: M0-009 architecture and CI checks remain required on every merge candidate.
Unresolved release and feature gates stay fail-closed and cannot be converted to passes by skips.
No production Shell or untrusted Provider is enabled, and physical writes remain sandbox-only until their named gates close.

gates.decision: ADR-0018 approves the owner-guarded per-user HKCU route. V03-006 and V03-005 prove the custom DLL is discovered and entered in real Windows 11 Explorer through ordinary unpackaged execution, with no HKLM fallback. G2-G4 and production distribution remain independent.
exit_criteria: Approved ADR names the supported per-user registration/deployment path.
Real Windows 11 evidence shows the custom DLL is discovered without HKLM.

gates.decision: V03-005 real Explorer evidence proves the approved view, missing Host, abrupt fault-host termination, silent timeout and invalid/partial frame recovery through reopening the root with a normal Core-backed Host. Owner-guarded native registration cleanup is independently verified. G3 timing/lifetime and G4 stability remain open.
exit_criteria: Custom Explorer view opens through the approved entry.
Host missing, crash, timeout and invalid frames recover without Explorer failure.
Owner-guarded uninstall leaves no registration residue.

gates.decision: V03-014 measurements in one real Explorer process satisfy the predeclared G3 profile: five fault/reopen samples, EnumObjects/Query/UI Refresh below250ms, completed cancellation cleanup below2s, rendered root recovery below10s, stable owned object/callback counts and zero live operations/pins. Controlled final Release remains verified. This does not claim immediate OS DLL unload or G4 soak coverage.
exit_criteria: Measured Explorer UI return, cancellation drain and normal-host reconnect meet documented bounds.
No detached worker or DLL lifetime leak remains after repeated recovery.

gates.decision: On 2026-09-12 the user explicitly waived G4 and requested G3 only. The original twenty-cycle and eight-hour requirements were not executed or verified; their release-blocking effect is waived. This administrative closure is not a test pass.
exit_criteria: Twenty real Explorer crash/restart cycles pass.
The documented eight-hour Explorer soak passes with bounded memory and no WER/Application Error event.

gates.decision: The console host may be implemented; Windows Service distribution remains blocked until an approved SCM cycle completes.
exit_criteria: Approved install, start, health, stop and uninstall cycle passes as LocalService.
Service, owner marker and task data residues are absent after uninstall.

gates.decision: V01-021 proves the NAS read-only Docker build, health/restart, non-root/read-only boundaries and owned container/network/volume cleanup. Other Alpha and physical-write gates remain independent.
exit_criteria: Image build and Compose health pass on a usable daemon.
Non-root, read-only root filesystem, writable data boundary and down-with-volume cleanup are observed.

gates.decision: Streaming implementation may proceed with small bounded fixtures; advertised 1/20/100 GiB tiers remain blocked.
exit_criteria: A user-approved empty fixed-NTFS sandbox passes canonical-boundary and capacity checks.
Sequential 1/20/100 GiB real-byte runs pass streaming hash, reopen verification and cleanup without sparse-file substitution.

gates.decision: Process-crash evidence is accepted for design work, but production physical writes cannot be enabled until the durability policy is proven.
gates.allowed_scope: Task-owned sandbox fixtures only; no production NAS mutation or power-loss durability claim.
exit_criteria: An ADR defines Windows file and namespace flush ordering plus unsupported guarantees.
Controlled power-loss/fault-lab evidence or a documented fail-closed recovery design meets source-preservation and strong-hash invariants.

gates.decision: Cooperative locks are insufficient against external namespace mutation; Linux production writes stay disabled outside a proven containment policy.
exit_criteria: ADR selects exclusive ownership, ACL or kernel containment semantics.
A release-like Linux host proves conflicts fail closed while preserving source and target evidence.

gates.decision: Job Object plus Restricted Token is resource control and privilege reduction, not a Windows file/network sandbox; Provider execution stays off.
gates.allowed_scope: Inert contract parsing and trusted test fixtures only; no untrusted Provider execution.
exit_criteria: AppContainer/Win32 app isolation or an equivalent profile denies undeclared filesystem and network access.
Job limits, process-tree cleanup and absolute request deadlines pass together.

gates.decision: Linux Provider execution stays off until release-like hard confinement is observed.
gates.allowed_scope: Inert contract parsing and trusted test fixtures only; no untrusted Provider execution.

gates.decision: Forced process-tree termination remains fallback, not protocol cancellation acknowledgement.

Missing acknowledgement falls back to bounded process-tree termination and reap without changing the original request result semantics.
